preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 lines describing edges following the first line.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= i and 'a' <= c <= 'v' for i, (p, c) in enumerate(edges, start=2))
preconditions.description: For each edge i (2 to n), the parent p is between 1 and i-1, and the character c is a lowercase letter from 'a' to 'v'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= results[v-1] <= n-1 for v in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible path length.

postconditions.expression: all(results[v-1] == max((len(path) for path in simple_paths_in_subtree(v) if is_dokhtar_kosh(path)), default=0) for v in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v, the output is the length of the longest simple path entirely within v's subtree such that the sequence of edge labels on the path can be rearranged into a palindrome (i.e., at most one character appears an odd number of times).
